Character sprites extracted from D.C.4 ~Da Capo 4~ Plus Harmony.

Due to the large number of character sprites and expression variants,
the complete character sprite collection has been divided into four galleries.

This collection contains the character sprites reconstructed from the
original game assets, including the available expression and sprite variants.

This gallery is Part 3 of 4 and the final part of the collection.

从《D.C.4 ～Da Capo 4～ Plus Harmony》
游戏资源中提取的人物立绘。

由于本作人物立绘及表情差分数量较多，
完整的人物立绘合集共分为四个画廊上传。

本合集收录从游戏原始资源中还原的人物立绘，
包含可用的表情差分及其他立绘差分。

本画廊为人物立绘合集第三卷，共四卷。
